brief:
Israeli forces have seized Palestinian land east of Qalqiliya to construct a military communications tower, Shehab Wire reported. The confiscation represents the latest instance of territorial appropriation in the occupied West Bank, where Israeli authorities have systematically expanded military infrastructure across Palestinian areas.

The seized properties lie in a region where Palestinian landowners have long faced confiscation for Israeli military installations and settlement expansion. Residents in the area have repeatedly documented loss of agricultural land and property to occupation authorities. No announcement specified the size of the seized plots or the expected completion date for the communications facility.
title: Israeli occupation seizes land east of Qalqiliya for military communications tower
